title.sk: Kurací curry s jogurtom a ryžou basmati
title.en: Chicken curry with yogurt and basmati rice

description.sk: Jemne pikantné kura v smotanovo-paradajkovej omáčke plnej korenia.
description.en: Mildly spicy chicken in a creamy tomato sauce full of spices.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na kocky, zmiešaj s jogurtom, polovicou garam masaly, kurkumou a soľou a nechaj aspoň 15 minút marinovať.
steps.en: Cut the chicken into cubes and mix with the yogurt, half the garam masala, the turmeric and salt. Marinate for at least 15 minutes.

steps.sk: Na oleji 8 minút pomaly opekaj nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu do zlatista. Pridaj cesnak, nastrúhaný zázvor, rímsky kmín a čili a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Slowly fry the finely chopped onions in the oil for 8 minutes until golden. Add the garlic, grated ginger, cumin and chili and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Prilej paradajky a var 10 minút, kým omáčka nezhustne. Medzitým uvar ryžu.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes until thickened. Meanwhile, cook the rice.

steps.sk: Pridaj mäso aj s marinádou a var 10 až 12 minút, kým kúsky nie sú vnútri biele a šťavnaté (74 °C).
steps.en: Add the chicken with its marinade and simmer for 10–12 minutes, until the pieces are white and juicy inside (74 °C).

steps.sk: Vmiešaj smotanu a zvyšnú garam masalu, prehrej a podávaj s ryžou a koriandrom.
steps.en: Stir in the cream and the remaining garam masala, heat through and serve with the rice and coriander.

title.sk: Dal z červenej šošovice s kokosovým mliekom
title.en: Red lentil dal with coconut milk

description.sk: Krémový, hrejivý a úplne rastlinný – výborný na varenie do zásoby.
description.en: Creamy, warming and fully plant-based, ideal for batch cooking.

steps.sk: Na oleji speň nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu, asi 6 minút. Pridaj cesnak, nastrúhaný zázvor, kurkumu a rímsky kmín a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Soften the finely chopped onion in the oil for about 6 minutes. Add the garlic, grated ginger, turmeric and cumin and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj prepláchnutú šošovicu, paradajky, soľ a 700 ml vody. Var 20 minút za občasného miešania, kým sa šošovica nerozvarí.
steps.en: Add the rinsed lentils, tomatoes, salt and 700 ml water. Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils break down.

steps.sk: Medzitým uvar ryžu podľa návodu.
steps.en: Meanwhile, cook the rice according to the packet.

steps.sk: Do dalu vmiešaj kokosové mlieko a garam masalu a povar ešte 3 minúty. Dochuť citrónovou šťavou a posyp koriandrom.
steps.en: Stir the coconut milk and garam masala into the dal and simmer for 3 more minutes. Finish with lemon juice and coriander.

description.sk: Korenisté cícerové curry so špenátom, hotové za pol hodiny.
description.en: A spicy chickpea curry with spinach, ready in half an hour.

steps.sk: Na oleji pomaly opekaj nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu do zlatista, asi 8 minút.
steps.en: Slowly fry the finely chopped onions in the oil until golden, about 8 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj cesnak, zázvor a všetko korenie okrem garam masaly a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Add the garlic, ginger and all the spices except the garam masala and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Prilej paradajky, pridaj prepláchnutý cícer, soľ a 150 ml vody a var 15 minút. Niekoľko cícerov roztlač, aby omáčka zhustla.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes, rinsed chickpeas, salt and 150 ml water and simmer for 15 minutes. Mash a few chickpeas to thicken the sauce.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj špenát a garam masalu, nechaj špenát zavädnúť a dochuť citrónovou šťavou.
steps.en: Stir in the spinach and garam masala, let the spinach wilt and finish with lemon juice.

title.sk: Aloo gobi – zemiaky s karfiolom na indický spôsob
title.en: Aloo gobi: Indian-style potatoes and cauliflower

description.sk: Suché zeleninové curry s kurkumou a rímskym kmínom.
description.en: A dry vegetable curry with turmeric and cumin.

steps.sk: Na oleji minútu opekaj rímsky kmín, pridaj nakrájanú cibuľu a opekaj 5 minút.
steps.en: Fry the cumin in the oil for a minute, add the chopped onion and fry for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj zázvor, cesnak, kurkumu a čili a potom zemiaky nakrájané na kocky. Opekaj 5 minút.
steps.en: Add the ginger, garlic, turmeric and chili, then the diced potatoes. Fry for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj ružičky karfiolu, nakrájané paradajky, soľ a 100 ml vody, prikry a var na miernom ohni 15 až 20 minút, kým zelenina nezmäkne.
steps.en: Add the cauliflower florets, chopped tomatoes, salt and 100 ml water, cover and cook over low heat for 15–20 minutes until tender.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj garam masalu a posyp koriandrom.
steps.en: Stir in the garam masala and sprinkle with coriander.

title.sk: Palak tofu – špenátové curry s tofu
title.en: Palak tofu: spinach curry with tofu

description.sk: Rastlinná obdoba palak paneer: krémový špenát s korením a opečeným tofu.
description.en: A plant-based take on palak paneer: creamy spiced spinach with fried tofu.

steps.sk: Uvar ryžu. Tofu nakrájaj na kocky a na polovici oleja ho opeč dozlatista. Odlož ho.
steps.en: Cook the rice. Cube the tofu and fry it in half the oil until golden. Set aside.

steps.sk: Špenát nechaj v hrnci s lyžicou vody zavädnúť, asi 3 minúty, a rozmixuj ho.
steps.en: Wilt the spinach in a pot with a spoonful of water, about 3 minutes, then blend it.

steps.sk: Na zvyšnom oleji speň cibuľu, pridaj cesnak, zázvor a korenie a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Soften the onion in the remaining oil, add the garlic, ginger and spices and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj špenát, kokosové mlieko a soľ, povar 5 minút, vmiešaj tofu a podávaj s ryžou.
steps.en: Add the spinach, coconut milk and salt, simmer for 5 minutes, stir in the tofu and serve with the rice.

description.sk: Severoindické domáce curry, sýte a lacné.
description.en: A North Indian home-style curry, filling and cheap.

steps.sk: Na oleji pomaly opekaj nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu do zlatista, asi 8 minút.
steps.en: Slowly fry the finely chopped onions in the oil until golden, about 8 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj cesnak, zázvor a korenie okrem garam masaly a minútu opekaj. Prilej paradajky a var 8 minút.
steps.en: Add the garlic, ginger and spices except the garam masala and fry for a minute. Add the tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj prepláchnutú fazuľu, soľ a 250 ml vody a var 15 minút. Časť fazule roztlač. Medzitým uvar ryžu.
steps.en: Add the rinsed beans, salt and 250 ml water and simmer for 15 minutes, mashing some of the beans. Meanwhile, cook the rice.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj garam masalu a podávaj s ryžou a koriandrom.
steps.en: Stir in the garam masala and serve with the rice and coriander.

description.sk: Indická omeleta s cibuľou, paradajkou, čili a koriandrom.
description.en: An Indian omelette with onion, tomato, chili and coriander.

steps.sk: Cibuľu, paradajku a čili nakrájaj nadrobno.
steps.en: Finely chop the onion, tomato and chili.

steps.sk: Vajcia rozšľahaj s kurkumou, soľou a koriandrom a vmiešaj zeleninu.
steps.en: Beat the eggs with the turmeric, salt and coriander and stir in the vegetables.

steps.sk: Vlej na rozohriaty olej a peč na strednom ohni 2 minúty, otoč a dopeč minútu.
steps.en: Pour into the hot oil and cook over medium heat for 2 minutes, flip and cook for another minute.
